_mirror.redaction: all canonical ids and free text replaced; topology and spatial attributes retained

lane-supports-reality.why: A supplied lane feeds accepted Reality. An UNSUPPLIED lane gets no edge — the absence is the finding.

checkpoint-attests-lane.why: A checkpoint is Signal's own computed assertion about a lane.

finding-concerns-lane.why: Signal's reading of which domain a finding is about.

finding-missing-from-lane.why: A sharper relation than `concerns` for the one type that asserts absence: requirements imply this work and execution does not contain it.

finding-evidenced-by-passage.why: A stored citation naming the exact EvidenceItem.

finding-evidenced-by-intelligence.why: A foreign key naming the accepted package.

finding-evidenced-by-source.why: A foreign key naming the pasted Source row.

requirement-belongs-to-scope.why: The snapshot the requirement was read from names the Scope it was assembled for.

requirement-evidenced-by-passage.why: The requirement IS this evidence row, read as a statement. Same row, two levels.

finding-concerns-requirement.why: The finding explicitly cites this evidence id, inside the same snapshot.

person-allocated-to-scope.why: A row naming both endpoints and the share of time between them.

person-attests-lane.why: Capacity is the lane people supply. Membership, so never drawn.

passage-extracted-from-source.why: The manifest entry the passage was read out of.

finding-linked-to-work.why: Linear identifiers the audit checked this claim against.

scope-depends-on-scope.why: A declared upstream Scope this one cannot finish ahead of.

gate-blocks-scope.why: THE ONLY WAY A DECISION REACHES THE FORECAST. A gate names what waits.

gate-gates-decision.why: The choice the gate is waiting on.

decision-resolves-finding.why: The audit finding this Decision was promoted from.

decision-attests-lane.why: The row exists; placing it on the Decisions lane is Signal's taxonomy.

dependency-attests-lane.why: As above: the edge exists, the lane is Signal's grouping.

work-implements-feature.why: Linear has no first-class Feature entity — a Feature IS the ancestor issue an implementation issue hangs from. The parent link is the only thing that says so.

feature-attests-lane.why: The Feature is real; placing it on the execution lane is Signal's grouping.

work-implements-work.why: Linear's own issue nesting: an implementation issue hangs from its Feature.

intel-cites-passage.why: The producer names an evidence id. The PASSAGE is then read from Signal's own accepted package, never from the claim — so a ref naming a row the package does not contain produces no edge.

intel-relates-intel.why: A relation the producer transported between two of its own objects. Carried in the direction sent — the bridge has already reversed the passive forms, and inverting again would point every longitudinal chain backwards.

registration-supersedes-registration.why: An unambiguous replacement pointer between tracked sources.
